items.difficulty_reason: The lemma classifies Gorenstein genus-zero proper curves as plane conics (statement lines 2108-2113). The proof (lines 2115-2133) is complete: the degree-two anti-dualizing sheaf, the closed immersion from its sections, the plane-curve genus restriction to degrees one and two, and the exclusion of the linear case by section independence. Every step is present with no omissions. H2: a short chain of correctly ordered standard inputs.
